subject: Workflow and execution-host identity
requested_information: Approved workflow UID/name/version, pool, namespace, node/boot, isolation/tenancy/resource ownership and approval chain
acceptable_response: Signed infrastructure export with effective state, acquisition UTC/native clocks and SHA256; distinguish intended/deployed/observed; no credentials

subject: Exact source/image/build/mount identities
requested_information: Registry distribution digests and local config IDs, layers/build provenance, source/overlay/binary/mount manifests, access/rights and release authority; resolve robot empty RepoDigests
acceptable_response: Read-only manifest plus build/installed hashes; identify config-ID versus registry-digest scheme; no tag substitution

subject: Simulator runtime capabilities
requested_information: Exact Isaac build/runtime/GPU-driver/toolkit dependencies; evidence native non-privileged direct runtime is supported; required device/capability/seccomp/mount list
acceptable_response: Version/export and vendor/platform policy artifact with reviewer; if unsupported state limitation, no implicit privileged fallback

subject: Scene/vehicle/cache identity
requested_information: Exact USD/dependency closure, Iris model/dynamics/sensors/airframe mapping, epoch/seed support, first-Play behavior and audited pre-existing warm artifact
acceptable_response: Hashed immutable offline assets; runtime state evidence identified separately; no new warm-up startup requested

subject: PX4 baseline and authoritative startup allocation
requested_information: Source, executable/build target, rcS/airframe10015/full params, frozen originals/approval chains including startup origin/budget and allowed deltas
acceptable_response: Authenticated originals with full hashes, decision references and applicability; excerpt or model key alone insufficient

subject: MAVLink/MAVROS/DDS effective interfaces
requested_information: Exact local/bind/peer/sysid/compid, plugin/dependency/QoS/RMW XML/security permissions, generated UDP/DDS port ranges and safe telemetry/service allowlist
acceptable_response: Signed effective endpoint/plugin/permissions manifests and provenance; identify automatic boot/control traffic and disallowed command APIs

subject: Network and command-boundary enforcement
requested_information: Effective deny-by-default ingress/egress/route/firewall/discovery policy, no domain1↔0/99 or operational bridges, bounded operator/evidence path
acceptable_response: Policy export with target namespace/host binding and validation method; domain or internal-network label alone insufficient

subject: Startup/shutdown/dependency semantics
requested_information: Actual image entrypoint/autostart/launcher hashes and finite P0/P1 schedule, independent fresh predicate, guard-host compatibility and termination tree
acceptable_response: Reviewed design/source/command manifest; no service activation or protected application requested

subject: Device/privilege/hardware exclusions
requested_information: No FC/actuator/USB/serial/CAN/radio connection, minimal GPU allowlist, host-device namespace/hotplug/mount/capability/userns policy and physical ownership
acceptable_response: Independent signed host/device inventory/deny attestation; absent ttyUSB/open-FD observation is not physical exclusion proof

subject: Security-policy capability
requested_information: Supported DDS identity/permissions enforcement or equivalent isolated middleware domain, least-privilege runtime and fail-closed policy load behavior
acceptable_response: Platform/policy evidence and proposed inert negative-test method; no operational endpoint probes

subject: Instrumentation and clock/recorder capability
requested_information: Available I01–I06 hooks/versions/event schemas, native clocks/UTC mapping uncertainty/reset markers, acquisition/drop/overhead/cadence and independent survival/exit contract
acceptable_response: Read-only existing artifacts; identify missing hooks and separately required active evidence; no live-ready inference from parser

subject: Operational ownership and emergency response
requested_information: Named operator/independent stop owner, exact target-only escalation/termination/recovery, numeric time/resource/storage/overhead bounds and scope expiry
acceptable_response: Signed assignments and reviewed bounded procedure with evidence ownership; no stop/restart permission inferred

subject: Frozen F00 and decision authority
requested_information: FR-01..FR-20 originals, A3 and applicable E9 approval chain, exact qualifying image/parameter disposition and developmental claim limits
acceptable_response: Authenticated read-only originals and full hashes, not reconstructed records; physical/release decisions retain scope

subject: Retention/durability/immutable attempt handling
requested_information: Independent executor/supervisor failure domains, bounded durable storage, archive/detached digest procedure and failed/aborted/incomplete/setup attempt retention
acceptable_response: Ownership/retention contract and existing evidence; no recorder fault test or external upload requested
